messages:
Anna P.: Quick sync — CloudWave Ops confirmed initial capacity for the new southwest AP node but KMS entitlements are still pending. Need legal + quota ticket before we schedule provisioning.
Liam K.: Can you share SKU and quota numbers so infra can validate?
Anna P.: SKU: CW-SW-EDGE-001, initial nodes: 4 (equiv G4dn), monthly commit: 12k GPU-hours. Partner says provisioning latency ~7 business days once entitlements are done.
CloudWave Ops: We can provision earlier if KMS ARN + marketplace account ID are provided. Also need the region billing contact.
Sana R.: Marketplace ID: proj-redwood-southwest. KMS plan: partner will use customer-managed key (partner account CMK) — Kayla, is that acceptable?
Kayla M.: Reviewing now. Main ask: limit key policy to encrypt/decrypt for the specific node service principal, and include audit logging. I'll draft a short clause.
Josh L.: For the onboarding runbook we'll need: preflight checks, test traffic profile, fallback routing to eu-west if capacity spikes, and health endpoints. I'll start a draft runbook doc.
marketplace-bot: Ticket #MK-7821 created for marketplace quota + entitlement. ETA: 48h for review.
Liam K.: If Kayla can finish the clause today and marketplace review stays on-track, can we aim for a dry-run on Wednesday 14:00 UTC?
CloudWave Ops: Tentative yes — nodes ready Tue EOD if entitlements are approved. FYI we have a 2Gbps nic on test VMs by default, live will be 5Gbps. Any egress constraints we should prep for?
Sana R.: No special egress rules from our end; we'll throttle tests to 1.5Gbps to be safe. We'll also limit test qps to match typical peak traffic.
Anna P.: Plan summary: Kayla finalizes KMS clause today; Sana submits KMS ARN to CloudWave; Liam + Josh finalize runbook and test profile; marketplace-bot ticket monitors quota approvals. I'll update partner thread and ops channel with final timeline.
Josh L.: I'll add health-check endpoints (/internal/ready, /internal/metrics) and a short test harness script. Can someone ping @eng-oncall for the test window?
Anna P.: pinging @eng-oncall now — please confirm coverage.
eng-oncall: Noted, we can cover Wed 14:00-17:00 UTC. Will standby and watch metrics.
Anna P.: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll post the final checklist and attach Kayla's clause when ready.
